_comment: Provenance for every plan fixture in this directory. See README.md. The gate in invariant-gates.sh refuses a fixture added or modified without a `captured` entry, and refuses any fixture on disk with no entry at all.

plan-noop.json.source: terraform plan -lock=false -target=google_pubsub_topic.traces_dlq against main at 807ff9c, post-Wave-3 (converged)
plan-noop.json.note: The shape that reached the approval gate twice on 2026-08-26: resource_changes present and every entry no-op. A guard written as `is the list empty` passes this.

plan-empty.json.source: terraform plan against a configuration declaring no resources
plan-empty.json.note: The other shape: `resource_changes` absent entirely rather than empty. Captured rather than trimmed from a real plan, so it is a genuine artifact of a real Terraform run.

plan-wave3.json.source: written 2026-08-26 alongside the invoker guard; field values taken from a real authenticated Wave 3 plan, but the document was composed by hand rather than produced by scrub_plan.py
plan-wave3.json.note: A real capture of this plan exists and was used to settle whether after.name is populated (W3.6). It was deliberately not substituted in: the directive establishing this rule forbids churning existing fixtures into captures, because a re-derivation that moved a guard's verdict would be indistinguishable from a regeneration. Upgrades to `captured` the next time a PR touches it.

plan-wave2.json.source: written during Wave 2; reconciled 2026-08-26 against real `terraform show -json` output after the invoker guard reported a violation against it
plan-wave2.json.note: Completed by hand from real plan output — the missing `name` and `member` fields were filled in from a real plan, not regenerated by the tool. Recorded as hand-authored because that is what it is; calling it `captured` would misdescribe the artifact this whole rule exists because of.

plan-clean.json.source: F0, the plan-guard's original passing fixture

plan-amendment-2.json.source: F2 ADR-0004 Amendment 4 (A2.4), the intended single-budget shape

plan-two-budgets.json.source: F2 ADR-0004 Amendment 4 (A2.4), two budgets bound to the kill-switch topic

plan-ingress-inverted.json.source: F2 W2.14, the worker opened to the internet

plan-ingress-undeclared.json.source: F2 W2.14, a service absent from INGRESS_POSTURE

plan-worker-public.json.source: F2 W3.6, allUsers invoker on the worker while ingress stays internal

plan-invoker-unresolved.json.source: F2 W3.6, an invoker binding the guard cannot read
